designation: Vice President and Managing Director, APAC
product_service: AI-powered B2B sales intelligence and personalised outreach automation platform.
value_proposition:
Helps B2B sales and business development teams at workforce solutions companies identify prospective enterprise clients using verified public business signals such as:
- Geographic expansion
- Hiring activity
- New facility openings
- Changing workforce requirements
It automates prospect research and generates personalised outreach drafts, helping teams prioritise promising accounts and identify potential demand for recruitment, staffing and outsourcing services.
